Surinder Agro Farm & FarmsKing Intelligence

Practical Agricultural R&D Laboratory | Created for Farmers' Empowerment

About Surinder Agro Farm

Surinder Agro Farm was established as a practical agricultural research field laboratory to directly study ground-level farming challenges, crop physiology, plant health, and natural organic farming solutions.

Rather than relying purely on theoretical assumptions, all algorithms and crop advisory routines on the FarmsKing Platform (farmsking.in) are practically tested in real crop fields at Surinder Agro Farm.

Chief Founder & Architect: Surinder Singh

Surinder Singh is the Lead Founder, Visionary, and Chief AI Architect behind FarmsKing and its supporting network of institutions:

  • Profession: Computer Teacher, IT Expert & Artificial Intelligence (AI) Specialist.
  • Educational Qualifications: Graduation in Computer Science (B.Sc CS), Master of Business Administration (MBA), and Bachelor of Laws (LLB).
  • End-to-End Execution: Spearheaded FarmsKing from initial idea, rapid deep study of agricultural science, software architecture, programming, feature development, to field testing.
  • Institutional Visionary: Founder of Surinder Academy (Est. 2001, Makhu), Exilent Web Solutions, Surinder Computers Makhu, and Surinder Agro Farm.
  • Mission: Dedicated to social service, farmer support, rural employment creation, and promoting chemical-free natural farming.
